intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi woke up, brushed her teeth, and got dressed ALL by herself!
But now... grumble, grumble... what is that sound? 🤔

scenes.title: The Tummy Drum
scenes.caption:
Tick-tock, twelve o'clock!
Kimi's tummy goes grrrrowl, like a little drum.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I'm hungry. I'm starving!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wait a second. I'll have lunch ready soon.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: What is for lunch?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: What about a sandwich? 🥪

scenes.title: The Waffle Surprise
scenes.caption: After lunch, a sweet smell floats from the kitchen...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Come and have a snack, Honey.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: What's my snack, Mom?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's your favorite — waffles!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Yay! ...Is there anything else? 😋

scenes.title: The Outside Promise
scenes.caption: Sunshine! The playground is calling Kimi's name!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, can I go play outside?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Go and play. But come back in an hour.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Just stay around the house. Don't go too far.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Promise! 🤙

scenes.title: Peek-a-Boo!
scenes.caption:
Kimi hides under the covers.
Shhh... don't giggle!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Where's my little baby? I can hear you...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: You can't see me, can you? 🤭

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: There you are! I got you!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: That was fun! Can we do it again?

scenes.title: The Great Block Tower
scenes.caption:
Red, blue, yellow, square...
How high can Kimi stack?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's play with the blocks. Get the blocks out!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Wow, all different shapes and colors! Mom, I need a blue piece.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Put the blue block on top of the yellow one. How many blocks can we stack?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look! I built a house!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You built a house! How nice! 🏠

ending.title: What a Yummy, Fun Day!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Kimi's Weather Adventure! ☀️🌧️⛄
